name: TOP MATERIAL Co., Ltd
summary: TOP MATERIAL Co., Ltd, established in 2012 and headquartered in Icheon, South Korea, specializes in the production and sale of primary cells, batteries, and accumulators. The company supplies crucial components including cathode materials, such as lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, which are indispensable for electric vehicle batteries. Its offerings also encompass primer coatings and electrodes. Furthermore, TOP MATERIAL provides a comprehensive suite of engineering services and specialized equipment aimed at designing and setting up manufacturing lines for various cell types—cylindrical, pouch, or AL prismatic—catering to both pilot-scale and giga-scale production demands.
